title: FIELDS
description: FIELDS — the Singular Map Rule census. One sun-centered lattice anchor; every concern is a separate renter: bodyFields, novaFields, collisionFields, impactField, forceField, burnMap. Shows renter count, channels used, lattice resolution (mapRuleRes), smoothing skip (mapRuleSkip), and per-renter write load. The Alignment Law lives here — if two renters disagree about the anchor, everything downstream shears. mapRuleOn is the master A/B for the whole machine.
